propositions: Mutating CLI verbs currently exit silently on success, making it impossible to distinguish successful writes from idempotent no-ops on stdout, forcing agents to run secondary `show` commands to verify state changes.

The unified confirmation contract must emit one stdout line per mutation following kubectl-style pattern — success lines like `linked src -> target (relation)`, no-op lines like `no change: already linked`, with past-tense verb and arguments only, built from CLI inputs and seam outcomes without follow-up store reads.

Global `--quiet` and `--output` flags must be extracted uniformly at the router level before partition dispatch to cover positional-only `_REGISTRY` leaves, with `--quiet` suppressing text confirmations only and `--output json` emitting a single-document envelope with outcome/subject/detail fields.

Existing machine-readable REDIRECT records from `link` must remain byte-identical on both write and no-op paths, including under `--quiet`, with no additional text confirmation line added in text mode.

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must be normalized to the shared confirmation contract preserving all information currently emitted, and `reopen` must gain its first confirmation line.

Consumed seam returns like `add_dependency`'s `dict | None` REDIRECT contract must remain unchanged; confirmation signals are added only as parallel channels or returned to unconsumed None-returning seams without altering consumed values.
